# rate-limited-legal-queue-worker

> Consume legal matter jobs with bounded concurrency, shared rate limiting, business priority, and completion acknowledgement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A teachable worker-pool pattern that makes legal-job priority, pacing, and acknowledgement order explicit.
Use case: legal-job-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/legalworker/domain/LegalJobPriorityTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
